projects.name: TensorForge
projects.summary: An analytical accelerator model paired with measured PyTorch/CUDA validation on one RTX 3050 Laptop GPU.
projects.limitations: Not cycle-accurate; the committed measurement is one capture on one physical laptop GPU and does not generalize to other devices.

projects.name: QuorumKV
projects.summary: A Raft key-value store with persistent state, linearizable reads, retry deduplication, snapshots, and captured leader failover.
projects.limitations: The captured local-loopback run is an observation, not a formal proof or production failover guarantee.

projects.name: ForgeCI
projects.summary: A distributed CI control plane with fenced leases, exact source revisions, durable recovery, and remote runners.
projects.limitations: A self-hosted systems study, not a hosted multi-tenant CI service.

projects.name: Wirestack
projects.summary: A userspace Ethernet-to-HTTP stack with TCP retransmission, Reno/NewReno, SACK, and Linux packet-level interoperability tests.
projects.limitations: No simultaneous open, DSACK, PRR, CUBIC/BBR/ECN, TLS, IPv4 fragmentation, or general-purpose DNS.

projects.name: EdgeCloud Vision Lab
projects.summary: A latency-aware vision scheduler with controlled failure injection, bounded local fallback, and reproducible experiment replay.
projects.limitations: The canonical run used two CPU workers on one machine and loopback HTTP, not a physical edge-to-cloud deployment.

projects.name: CommerceCore
projects.summary: A correctness-focused commerce backend for inventory races, ambiguous payments, and at-least-once delivery.
projects.limitations: A bounded single-merchant correctness laboratory, not a complete storefront.

projects.name: PageDB
projects.summary: A C23 database engine with persistent pages, a buffer pool, heaps, B+ trees, physical operators, and a read-only SQL subset.
projects.limitations: SQL is read-only and single-table; transactions, WAL, crash recovery, optimizer, and Java client are unfinished.

projects.name: PgSentry
projects.summary: A PostgreSQL reliability lab covering failover, partitions, migration safety, WAL archiving, PITR, and observability.
projects.limitations: Lab evidence does not establish a managed production service or SLO.

projects.name: Aegis
projects.summary: A GitOps Kubernetes lab that tests security and reliability controls with deliberate failures and recorded recovery evidence.
projects.limitations: Evidence is bounded to development environments; home K3s is single-node and backups lack PITR.

projects.name: Personal Cognitive Load Monitor
projects.summary: CogniFlow is an educational MLOps platform using deterministic synthetic cognitive-load proxy labels, authenticated FastAPI endpoints, and replay-safe event processing.
projects.limitations: Synthetic and nonclinical; the release does not establish Kubernetes or GCP deployment, an image release, clinical validation, or production operation.

projects.name: MatchSense
projects.summary: Event-driven football analytics with idempotent ingestion and cross-service tracing.

projects.name: Market Pulse
projects.summary: A local Iceberg lakehouse with incremental ingestion, dbt transformations, and data-quality gates.
projects.limitations: Validated locally rather than as a hosted data platform.

projects.name: Linux Kernel Lab
projects.summary: A custom QEMU boot, GDB early-boot workflow, and message-oriented character device driver.
projects.limitations: A focused learning lab, not a general kernel distribution.

projects.name: Company Research
projects.summary: A full-stack company research application with pgvector retrieval and streamed resume-fit evaluation.
projects.limitations: No public hosted demonstration is recorded.
